choke.title: choke
choke.display:
**verb** /tʃəʊk/

**英英释义**：to have difficulty breathing because something is blocking your throat; in the phrase 'choke back', it means to suppress or hold back (emotions, tears, etc.).

**中文释义**：文中含义：抑制，忍住（眼泪、情感等）。其他常见含义：窒息；使窒息；阻塞。

---

**例句**：He choked back tears as he explained to my sister that he would miss her eighth-grade graduation ceremony that night.
他强忍住眼泪，向妹妹解释说他将错过她当晚的八年级毕业典礼。

---

**搭配**：choke back tears, choke on something
**派生**：choked (adj.), choking (adj./n.)
**词源**：来自古英语 cēocian，拟声词。
**同义词**：suppress, hold back, stifle

medically induced coma.title: medically induced coma
medically induced coma.display:
**短语** /ˈmɛdɪkli ɪnˈdjuːst ˈkoʊmə/

**英英释义**：A temporary coma intentionally caused by administering drugs, often to reduce brain swelling or allow the brain to rest and heal.

**中文释义**：文中含义：为保护大脑或促进恢复而使用药物诱导的昏迷状态。其他常见含义：无。

---

**例句**：After yet another seizure—my third of the day—I was put into a medically induced coma and placed on a ventilator.
在当天第三次癫痫发作后，我被置于医学诱导昏迷状态并接上呼吸机。

---

**搭配**：place in a medically induced coma, induce a medically induced coma
**派生**：无
**词源**：medically（医学上）+ induced（诱导的）+ coma（昏迷）
**同义词**：induced coma, pharmacologic coma

rebound.title: rebound
rebound.display:
**动词** /rɪˈbaʊnd/

**英英释义**：recover in value, strength, or health; bounce back.

**中文释义**：文中含义：恢复（健康、力量等）。其他常见含义：反弹，回升；弹回。

---

**例句**：By the next morning my breathing had rebounded to the point where the doctors felt comfortable releasing me from the coma.
到第二天早上，我的呼吸已恢复到医生认为可以放心让我脱离昏迷的程度。

---

**搭配**：rebound from, rebound to
**派生**：rebounder, rebounding
**词源**：来自中古英语，源自盎格鲁-法语reboundir，意为“弹回”。
**同义词**：recover, bounce back, rally
